title: Stranded-Order Concession on Discontinued Item Close-Outs, Contract Pricing Agreement
content:
## Stranded-order concession — Contract Pricing Agreement discontinued item close-out

The stranded-order concession follows the quantity of the discontinued item's latest backorder that was filled with the substitute, as the backorder fill lines on the customer's Ship-To Fulfillment Account records show it.

- 100 units or more: 1.5 percent off.
- At least one and fewer than 100 units: 0.75 percent off.
- None: nothing off.

An amount equal to that percent of the close-out price is taken off the close-out price before its rounding to four decimal places.

Hypothetical example: a backorder of 120 units filled with the substitute and a close-out price of 8.0000: 1.5 percent of 8.0000 is 0.1200, giving 7.8800.
